value.rationale: A natural model ingredient—uncertain amplitudes when an external Brownian driving noise is refreshed—raises a physically and mathematically motivated question about stationary central concentration. The result is a complete shape/variance phase classification, not an unmotivated single parameter computation: it identifies an exact universal boundary for a sign reversal across all symmetric seed distributions and proves all regimes nonempty.
